request.prompt: Write a complete original instrumental for an atmospheric futuristic electric-car radio station. Strictly no voices, singing, speech, vocal chops, choir, whispers, or vocoder. Original melodies and sound design only; no quotations or samples of existing music. Polished warm stereo mix, controlled bass, smooth high frequencies, and space for vehicle sound effects. Start with an established pulse, develop a restrained recurring motif, vary the arrangement every eight bars, keep momentum throughout, and end on the ongoing groove without silence or a dramatic finale. Cinematic downtempo electronica at 78 BPM, 4/4, approximately 32 bars. Slow firm broken-beat drums with a satisfying snare, deep warm bass, sparse reverberant electric-piano notes, distant analog strings and soft granular synthesizer stars. An immense dark Texas desert beneath satellites, lonely but hopeful. Strong unhurried head-nodding groove, a memorable original three-note electric-piano motif and deep atmosphere, not sleep music, no vinyl crackle.
